reuse.tetrad: Retain backend-adapter candidate; preserve endpoint pairs,lags,knowledge and weights. Defer code port pending GPL/dependency review and native comparison; general PAG/effect promises rejected.
reuse.banjo: Reference-only modified mirror; no direct commercial adoption or source port under unresolved restrictive rights. Independent boundary/configuration ideas are useful; resolve official version and discreteness assumptions.
reuse.weka: Forecast/preprocessing comparator under declared package/GPL scope; retain original clocks,series and transformations. Do not register as causal temporal/interventional estimator.
reuse.learndbn: Conditional isolated-worker prototype for discrete longitudinal structure learning after license/dependency review. Reject default adoption until stationarity flag,process exit,EM budget and graph export defects/limits are addressed.
reuse.learndbm: Related clustering comparator,not an independently qualified causal regime learner; inspect MultiNet internals and membership/uncertainty before enabling.
reuse.builder: Reference candidate for model-supplied EM only; direct integration/port deferred for unresolved rights,maintenance and native behavior.

request: Unit and series identity,event/availability clocks,calendar and timezone,lag units and admissible windows
Variables,categories,missingness law,train-only transformation policy,stationarity and contemporaneous restrictions
Regime identity,known intervention target/type,assignment evidence,unchanged-mechanism assumptions and estimand population
Pinned source/runtime/dependency identities,score mode/effective weights,randomization and computational budgets
response: Typed lagged graph with original endpoint pairs; separate visualization projection
Actual window/series/calendar counts,component sample sizes and weights; never invent total sample size from mean accessor
Selected graph versus graph-family uncertainty versus effect identification/coverage separately
Warnings,unsupported conditions,nonconvergence and backend process failure retained in result denominator
repair_sequence: Write a clock/series/regime validator and lossless endpoint/lag contract before connecting backends.
Make Tetrad weighting explicit; verify individual sample-size fields and calibrated uncertainty independently.
For learnDBN propagate the actual stationarity flag through all missing-data calls or refuse that combination; replace System.exit at library boundary or isolate worker.
Add iteration,allocation,timeout and numerical-status limits to EM; preserve intra-slice edges outside compact display.
Review licenses and complete environments before source adoption/port; run native golden cases only in a prospective prototype.

public_generated_comparison.independent_units: Entire generated mechanisms/trajectories; shared-calendar clusters kept together
public_generated_comparison.public_data_role: Realistic calendars,missingness and documented public assignments; a public observation or forecast label is not causal gold.
metrics: Identified-set/effect coverage and width under a justified law
freeze_before_study: Pilot-informed fixed replications and stopping rule

open_research: Dependent graph-family retention with shared calendars and hidden causes
Useful effect bounds across observationally equivalent models
Intervention invariance/assignment truth and selection; public evidence only resolves documented cases
